messages:
Zoe (CEO): Quick ask after today's all-hands: can I get a partner-friendly one-liner status + the single top risk for API, Console, and Optimize? Keep it short so I can paste into the partner note.

Mara (Product): API: limited developer preview next week; benefit line: smoother integrations via updated auth and SDKs. Biggest risk: the auth switch may affect long-lived connections in dedicated deployments.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirmed. We'll start a 10% canary and monitor connection stability metrics. Rollback plan is in place.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: opt-in canary for route analytics and refreshed onboarding slated for June. Biggest risk: telemetry v2 event schema hasn't been finalized across SDKs and docs.

Sam (Docs): I'll finish the telemetry schema doc and examples by tomorrow AM and post the partner-friendly copy.

Alex (Optimize): Optimize: internal preview of automated batching and cache recommendations to cut per-token spend. Biggest risk: some customers will need an explicit opt-out for auto-suggestion UX. I'll file the ticket.

Riley (SRE): Note: the auth rollout requires a routing sync that may surface as brief (1-3 min) reconnections for certain long-lived streams. We're testing a zero-blip path but it's not guaranteed yet.

Ops (Release): Please get FINAL_SIGNOFF tags on release tickets by Fri 17:00 UTC so we can reserve canary windows and send customer notices.

Mara (Product): Draft partner-friendly one-liners (benefits-first):
- API: "Limited preview: improved security and SDK alignment to make integrations easier."
- Console: "Opt-in preview: clearer route-level insights to help teams measure and troubleshoot performance."
- Optimize: "Preview: automated recommendations to reduce inference cost while keeping quality."

Zoe (CEO): These look good. Make the language even less technical for partners; focus on outcomes.

Jess (Eng PM): Edited for partners:
- API: "Preview: tighter security and more consistent SDKs to simplify integrations."
- Console: "Preview: opt-in route insights to help teams track performance."
- Optimize: "Preview: suggestions to lower inference costs without changing results."

Alex (Optimize): Filed ticket OPS-9402 for opt-out checkbox in the preview flow.

Comm (Marketing Bot): Draft announcement queued for review: "Limited previews: API auth + SDKs, Console route insights, Optimize cost suggestions". Tagging Mara for copy approval.

Sam (Docs): I'll upload the three partner bullets + a short FAQ about opt-in/opt-out by tomorrow noon.

Kevin L (Eng): We'll run an extra validation pass on long-lived connections tonight and post results by 06:00 UTC. If we see regressions, we won't proceed with full rollout.

Riley (SRE): Agreed. If validation fails, we'll pause and plan a zero-downtime approach.

Mara (Product): Thanks all. Zoe, I'll ping you with the final one-liners once Sam posts the doc copy. If anything changes during the canary, we call it out immediately in this thread.

Zoe (CEO): Thanks team. Please keep notifications here; I'll hold off messaging partners until I see Sam's final copy. :thumbsup:
